name: Descendants of the Sun
description: After a chance meeting in a hospital, an ardent soldier falls for a gifted surgeon. Opposing philosophies tear them apart, but fate has other plans.

videos.title: Highlights of Descendants of the Sun
videos.overview: This special episode of Descendants of the Sun presents highlights of the drama that shows you the ups and down of Si Jin and Mo Yeon. The scenes will take you back to Urk and make you recall all the dramatic happenings between the two characters.

videos.title: More Highlights of Descendants of the Sun
videos.overview: The special episode of Descendants of the Sun featuring drama highlights continues. The scenes take you back to the happy and sad days the characters went through. Stay tuned to reminisce the past happenings which will fill your heart with many different emotions.

videos.title: Behind The Scenes Footage
videos.overview: The best behind the scenes footage of each Episode with bloopers and outtakes.

videos.title: Will You Be My Doctor?
videos.overview: While on vacation after a sensitive military operation, soldier Si-jin senses a connection with Mo-yeon, a beautiful and strong-willed surgeon.

videos.title: We Bump Into Each Other While Passing By
videos.overview: Si-jin and Dae-young engage in a perilous operation in Afghanistan, while Mo-yeon assists in surgery. Later, Si-jin and Mo-yeon take in a movie.

videos.title: How Have You Been?
videos.overview: Si-jin and Alpha Team join Mo-yeon and the doctors in Urk. Meanwhile, Myung-ju doesn't like how her father, Lt. Gen. Yoon, treats Dae-young.

videos.title: I Will Find a Way to Drink
videos.overview: Tempers flare over a dying man when Mo-yeon insists she can save the patient's life. Meanwhile, Dae-young and Myung-ju reunite at the airport.

videos.title: What Should I Do About the Kiss
videos.overview: After sharing a moment, Mo-yeon isn't sure what to think about her relationship with Si-jin. Later, Si-jin receives a panicked phone call.

videos.title: I Shouldn't Have Received His Apology
videos.overview: After a powerful earthquake strikes Urk, the country descends into chaos. It's up to the medical team and soldiers to search for survivors.

videos.title: I Missed You
videos.overview: In the earthquake's aftermath, heartbreaking decisions must be made by Si-jin and Mo-yeon, who both strive to save as many people as possible.

videos.title: Comfort the Deceased With a Silent Prayer
videos.overview: When an aftershock strikes, Mo-yeon sees firsthand just how dangerous Si-jin's job can be. Later, an old phone message is accidentally broadcast.

videos.title: That Wasn't Me
videos.overview: Mo-yeon is embarrassed after her unintentional confession, but Si-jin isn't about to let her off the hook. Meanwhile, a visitor makes everyone nervous.

videos.title: You Got A Parcel From Shin Ji Young
videos.overview: Dae-young is rattled after seeing an old nemesis, Mo-yeon shares a dark dinner with Si-jin, and an unusual package arrives from home.

videos.title: Who on Earth Stole It?
videos.overview: While Dae-young and Myung-ju remain quarantined, the rest of the team fights the epidemic. Meanwhile, the supply truck with the cure disappears.

videos.title: As of This Moment, Everyone Will Return to Team Alpha
videos.overview: Dae-young has a bad feeling about Si-jin's solo mission into Agus's hideout. Mo-yeon wonders if she's capable of dealing with Si-jin's secrecy.

videos.title: You're Not My Director Any More
videos.overview: The medical team returns to their regular lives, but something's off. Meanwhile, Mo-yeon makes a bold career move, and Dae-young faces a tough choice.

videos.title: The Movie We Missed
videos.overview: After a patient is rushed to the hospital, Mo-yeon is shocked to see who is in need of care. Meanwhile, a microchip reveals unexpected information.

videos.title: I Will Stay Alive
videos.overview: Si-jin and Mo-yeon spend some much deserved time together. Dae-young and Myung-ju continue to have communication problems. Devastating news arrives.

videos.title: This Is Unbelievable
videos.overview: Mo-yeon and Myung-ju learn that not everything is what it seems. Meanwhile, a promotion is cause for celebration, and a trip reignites old passions.
